category_title: Student with language impairment who uses loud noises and physical aggression to avoid tasks
scenario_title: Independent work on challenging worksheets without teacher attention
minimal_context: Terrance is assigned to complete a reading comprehension worksheet independently at his desk in the pull-out special education classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is your reading comprehension worksheet. Please complete these questions on your own at your desk while I check on the other group.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pushes the worksheet away) No, I'm not doing this.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try your best and keep working on the questions.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Starts making loud siren noises and banging his hands on the desk) Ahhhh! Woooo!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please be quiet and look at your paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Grabs his pencil and throws it at the student sitting next to him, yelling loudly) I said I'm not doing it! Look at me!

task.content: Independent reading, math, or writing worksheets that the student, with assistance, was unlikely to complete with 50% or better accuracy

context.environment: Pull-out special education classroom at an elementary school
context.materials: Independent reading, math, or writing worksheets
context.social_setting: General classroom instruction and work time

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When teacher attention was absent during hard tasks
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Making loud noises during class, interrupting others, refusal to work when given tasks, and physical aggression directed toward peers
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Fatigue with the trials or whether some other setting event was present

behavior_patterns.condition: In the presence of challenging tasks
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Clear history of off-task and problem behavior
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Repeated failure experienced across their schooling
